title: LIVERPOOL LED TWICE IN ISTANBUL. THEN THE PERFECT START WAS OVER
description:
Four-three against Villarreal was the warning sign. Istanbul was the proof.

Liverpool arrived with a perfect start in the Champions League. Nyoni and Isak scored for them, and they led twice. Fenerbahce came back both times.

Greenwood, Archie Brown and Vedat Muriqi scored for the hosts. Muriqi came off the bench to do it. Final score: 3-2, and Fenerbahce's first points of the competition. Liverpool's perfect start? Perfect until Istanbul.

Did Fenerbahce earn it, or did Liverpool give it away? Pick a side.
